#!/bin/bash
set -e
exec > >(tee /var/log/user-data.log) 2>&1
dnf install -y nodejs aws-cli
mkdir -p /opt/app && cd /opt/app
aws s3 sync s3://minijira-deploy-irastack/ .
npm install --production
export PORT=3000
export AWS_REGION=us-east-1
export COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID=

export TABLE_TEAMS=Teams
export TABLE_PROJECTS=Projects
export TABLE_TASKS=Tasks
export TABLE_COMMENTS=Comments
export TABLE_ACTIVITY_LOG=ActivityLog
export TABLE_USERS=Users
export S3_BUCKET_ORIGINALS=minijira-originals-irastack
export S3_BUCKET_RESIZED=minijira-resized-irastack
export SNS_TOPIC_ARN=arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:362612349549:minijira-assignments
node dist/index.js &
